summary: Diff confirms the fix touches only MCP-only code (_normalized_artifact_target) plus decide_dependencies/docstrings; _match_rest, _REST_ACTIONS, and the FastAPI route decorators are untouched. Tests cover all three angles genuinely: the real Starlette Route object's own .matches() proves {name} still uses the default single-segment convertor (Match.NONE for a multi-segment path, Match.FULL for single-segment) independent of the auth layer; raw-ASGI-driven requests (bypassing httpx's client-side dot-segment collapsing) prove server-side denial of an unresolved dot-segment traversal and a raw multi-segment name; and plain + punctuation-bearing legitimate reads still round-trip exact bytes, ruling out an accidental over-tightening. No counterexample found for 'existing'/'pattern'/'matching behavior' that these four tests would miss.
